verdict.rationale: Munito AI's marketing site has one line saying requests can be sent to Munito Compute Cloud "or to your own cloud." That suggests a customer-cloud deployment option for its own inference, but nothing else describes self-hosting. The rest of the evidence shows a hosted API service reached through api.munito.ai base URLs. Missing for 10: self-hosting or installation documentation, deployment artifacts (images or packages), licensing terms for self-hosting, a clear statement of which components run in the customer's environment, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: It then sends the request to Munito Compute Cloud, which sits in front of a pixel map of Europe, or to your own cloud.
